candidates.description: These tokens represent indefinite quantifiers and determiners used to specify amount or quantity.
This vector represents degree adverbs and qualifiers that modify adjectives, verbs, or other adverbs to express extent or limitation.
This vector represents comparative adjectives expressing degree, scale, or temporal relation.
This vector represents physical contact, reaching, and deliberate interaction with surfaces or body parts.
This feature vector represents concepts related to benefit, advantage, and positive outcomes, alongside antonyms and morphological variants denoting gains or favors.
This vector represents common present and past tense verbs denoting actions and occurrences.
These tokens represent adverbs of frequency, time, and occurrence that modify verbs or clauses to indicate how often or when an action takes place.
This vector represents actions involving grasping, acquiring, or sports-related plays.
This vector activates in contexts related to baseball players, positions, and terminology.
This vector represents active present participle verbs indicating ongoing physical or abstract actions.
